description: Fatemeh Jalayer and Hossein Ebrahimian publish Jupyter notebooks for inspecting ETRiS tsunami fragility and vulnerability curves. The current VisualizeFragility repository loads CSV inputs, detects damage levels and plots mean and mean-plus-or-minus-sigma curves with Plotly. Its February 2026 archive states GPL-3.0. This record also explicitly covers the earlier May 2025 Zenodo bundle 15477238, which supplies VisualizeFragility and VisualizeVulnerability together under CC BY 4.0. Both are freely downloadable; the differing release licences should be retained. Geographic coverage and observation periods follow the selected empirical datasets. The notebooks help check risk-model inputs, while catalogue record model-etris-simulation-based-ptra-building supplies related simulation context. Technical compatibility, uncertainty calculations and equivalence between releases were not tested. Users must supply the required curve tables separately. Only metadata and README documentation were inspected; notebook execution was not checked.
